decisions.reason: It stayed prominently listed through 2024 in a growing market, and as a close extension of the core range its option value likely still exceeds its carrying cost.

Its continued full-page presence after launch suggests acceptable market fit, and a ceiling luminaire close to the established offer is inexpensive to keep relative to the value of maintaining the option.
Launched only in 2024, it is still in the high-uncertainty phase where a design-led lighting firm would usually preserve the option unless clear failure appears.
Because it builds on the firm's modular lighting logic, it likely complements existing systems and can be retained at modest cost while demand information develops.
This is also a system-related extension with early-stage uncertainty, so management is likely to keep it for now, though its more specialized low-voltage use raises the drop risk somewhat.

Its lighter website treatment points to weaker commitment or traction than the others, but as a close-to-core design variant in a broad portfolio it is still more likely to be kept than withdrawn immediately.
